name: io.github.iris-eval/mcp-server
description: Stop shipping agents on vibes. Score every agent output for quality, safety, and cost.

environmentVariables.description: API key for HTTP authentication (optional, recommended for production)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: SQLite database path
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOME

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one judge or citation call (default 0.25)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL

environmentVariables.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH

environmentVariables.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD

environmentVariables.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT

environmentVariables.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS

environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS

environmentVariables.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-mcp)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OTEL_TIMEOUT_MS
